gen-almendra-display-gf-roboto-condensed: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary hand with open, never-pinched letters, while Roboto Condensed below runs tight and enlarged, almost wire-thin in feel. Their strongest quality is the pull between flourish and restraint.
gen-almendra-display-gf-saira-semi-conde: Saira Semi Condensed looks magnified without growing, its weight steady from word to word, set under Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading. A long page would move along smoothly and quietly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-secular-one: Heavy midsections swallow the line height in Secular One, with no variation in stroke anywhere along the line. And over a full page that sans-serif body stays blunt and dense, a stark foil to Almendra Display's hairline-rich ornament.
gen-almendra-display-gf-smooch-sans: Never pinching shut, Almendra Display's ornate, literary letters rise on a pronounced x-height above Smooch Sans, whose lines pack tightly. A longer read would feel compact but friendly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-sofia-sans-conde: Approachable and contemporary, Sofia Sans Condensed leaves its curves unfinished, like a fineliner lifted mid-loop. Under Almendra Display's ornate heading, a long passage would feel flat, big and quick to scan.
gen-almendra-display-gf-spline-sans-mono: Typewriter precision meets storybook flourish here. Almendra Display's ornate heading gives the page its voice, and Spline Sans Mono's fixed-width, drafting-pen letters lay down a technical grid beneath it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-strait: Strait fills its lowercase with big round bowls, friendly and contemporary beneath the heading. And Almendra Display, ornate and literary, adds the flourish that lets those simple shapes feel deliberate.
gen-almendra-display-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 stands tall, so its ascenders look short. Under Almendra Display's ornate heading, a longer passage would read as chunky, clean and surprisingly approachable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-truculenta: Almendra Display's letters never seem to pinch shut, giving its ornate, literary heading a generous, open feel. Truculenta crowds its short-ascender, tall-x-height sans-serif into a compact line, so a long page reads dense yet approachable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-ubuntu: Storybook flourish up top, lofty lowercase below. Their strongest quality is the lift: Almendra Display's ornate, literary letters meet Ubuntu, a sans-serif with a tall, steady band.
